findings: PinnedVersions splits the path at '/', then passes the final JSON-Pointer token directly to remove_prop. This fails for property names containing '/' or '~': encoded tokens (for example @scope~1pkg) are not decoded, while unencoded scoped package names are split at the wrong slash. The removal can therefore target the wrong property or leave the pinned entry behind.
evidence: The new code uses path_to_prop.rfind('/') and passes &path_to_prop[parent_path + 1..] as prop_name without JSON-Pointer token decoding.
gaps: No tests or path-format contract are included to establish whether dependency_type.path is a JSON Pointer and whether remove_prop expects encoded or decoded property names.
